nodes.Name: osDefaultInheritEnv
Handler
nodes.DocComment: Handler runs an executable in a subprocess with a CGI environment.

Fields.Name: Root
Fields.DocComment: root URI prefix of handler or empty for "/"

Fields.Name: Env
Fields.DocComment: extra environment variables to set, if any, as "key=value"

Fields.Name: InheritEnv
Fields.DocComment: environment variables to inherit from host, as "key"

Fields.Name: Logger
Fields.DocComment: optional log for errors or nil to use log.Print

Fields.Name: Args
Fields.DocComment: optional arguments to pass to child process

Fields.Name: Stderr
Fields.DocComment: optional stderr for the child process; nil means os.Stderr
